metadata.scope: Reject guessed codex: AI-effect routing with one typed diagnostic while preserving explicit models.yml OpenAI routing for codex-family API models.
metadata.planner_note: The design's v0.39.0 target is historical; select the next minor release and current unreleased changelog at execution time.
metadata.implementation_gate: User must explicitly say execute sprint before sprint-executor starts.

velocity.loc_note: 220 = 90 M1 + 80 M2 + 50 M3. Seven-day history contains only the v0.42.0 release, so the estimate uses inspected surface area plus contingency rather than a misleading recent LOC/day rate.

features.description: Remove the codex prefix from GuessProvider's OpenAI guesses and add a shared typed model-resolution error/helper that explains the executor-only billing ruling.
acceptance_criteria: GuessProvider returns empty for codex:gpt-5-codex, mixed-case CODEX:, and bare codex-max
GuessProvider still returns OpenAI for gpt-5-codex, gpt-*, o1-*, and o3-* positive controls
The resolution error is discoverable with errors.As, preserves the model, and names executor lane, unavailable ChatGPT OAuth, no silent metered fallback, and explicit-registry migration

features.description: Use the shared typed error in CLI AI-effect and eval-adapter fallback construction, with negative codex: tests and explicit provider:openai registry precedence controls.
acceptance_criteria: CLI AI-effect construction rejects codex: before provider/client construction with the typed diagnostic
Eval adapter construction rejects codex: with the identical typed diagnostic
Explicit provider: openai construction for a codex-family API model succeeds without guessing or network calls
Existing config-driven, OpenRouter, Ollama, Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI routing tests remain green

features.description: Re-scan AI-effect codex: usages, add the next-minor migration note, run repository gates, and prove executor auth and mission-control billing guards are untouched.
acceptance_criteria: No unexplained repository AI-effect codex: usage remains; executor role pins are classified as unaffected
The current unreleased changelog documents loud failure plus executor-lane and explicit-registry migration choices
make test, make lint, and make check-boundaries pass or unrelated base failures are reproduced and recorded
No diff exists under internal/executor/codex or tools/launchd/mission-control.sh
Final landing commit uses Fixes #903; earlier commits use refs #903

risks: Over-broad rejection could block deliberate API use; preserve gpt-* guessing and test explicit registry OpenAI precedence.
Two fallback consumers could drift; centralize typed error construction and test both.
Billing-path tests could accidentally require credentials or network; stop at handler/adapter construction with injected test configuration.
The design release target is stale; select the current unreleased next-minor changelog during execution.
